void.noReason: No reason was recorded — this predates the requirement.
void.staysOnTrail: It stays on record for the audit trail and counts towards no total.
void.title: Withdraw this figure
void.explain: An approved figure cannot be edited. If it is wrong — a double count, a misread invoice — withdrawing it takes it out of every total and reopens the period, so a corrected figure can be entered in its place.
void.reasonLabel: Reason (required, and it goes on the permanent record)
void.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this figure being withdrawn?
void.confirmTitle: Withdraw this figure from the inventory?
void.reasonRequired: A reason is required — a withdrawal has to say why.
void.reasonShort: Say why this figure is being withdrawn — at least {min} characters ({count} so far).
void.reasonLong: A reason cannot run past {max} characters ({count} entered).
void.removes: This removes {tonnes} tCO₂e from the inventory.
void.noFigure: This entry produced no tCO₂e figure, so no emissions total changes.
void.subject: {category} · {subsidiary} · {entity} · {period} {year}
void.stopsCounting: It stops counting towards totals, reports and invoice coverage.
void.reopens: {period} {year} then reopens for {entity}, so a corrected {category} figure can be entered in its place.
void.staysOnRecord: The entry stays on record with your reason, and the withdrawal is written to the audit log.
void.printed: Your reason is printed verbatim in every generated report — PDF, Excel and CSV — and cannot be edited afterwards.
void.withdrawnNoFigure: Withdrawn — the entry no longer counts towards any total.
